fixture_manifest.policy: Development fixture, frozen before first execution; not an untouched final. Seeds change identities only. Train diagonal prepare/finish paths; hold out crossed complete paths while every adjacent action pair is observed. Coupled world requires matching tickets. Supplied roles, state/resource contracts and atomic effects are identical for all systems. No adoption labels, forced adoption, threshold tuning or paper-reproduction claim. Record every failure.

manifest.policy: Keep previous G3.4 seeds, worlds, queries, labels and candidate gates unchanged. Compare complete results with candidate on/off, append, cold index, reload and instrumentation. Alternate paired timing order. Measure whole rebuild after append, actual fresh save_state files including validation and fsync, load plus separate index rebuild, and separate tracemalloc index allocations. Opt-in index; direct source edits require invalidation. No production latency, p99, incremental-update or condensation claim.
